paite: Pathian aw, ka mangbat thu ah ka aw na za inla; melmate lauhhuaina lak ah ka hinna humbit in.
heading: David La / Humbitna Dia Thumna

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte kihou gukna lak ah hon sel in; thil hihkhialte buaina lak ah.
Amau namsau bang in alei uh atat-hiam ua, athu khate ngei uh thalte bang a kap ding in angim ua.
Mi gensiatbeite mundai a akaptheihna ding un; lau lou in khatvei thu in akap guih ngal uhi.
Thil gilou hih ding in sakithuhilh ua; thang aguk a kam thu bang ah akihou zel ua; "Kua'n huaite amu dia?" achi uhi.
Thulimlouhna azongkhia ua; "Hahkattak in i zongta," achi ua, asunglam ngaihtuahna leh lungtang uh thuktak ahi ngal a.
Himahleh Pathian in thal in amaute akap ding a, Thakhat in liam in a-om ding uhi.
Huchibang in, amau lei ngei a amau adou ziak in, kisui in a-om ding ua; amau mute'n alu uh asing ding uhi.
Huchi in mi tengteng in alau ding ua; Pathian nasep agen ding uhi, athilhih piltak in angaihtuah ding uhi.
Midiktatte TOUPA ah akipak ding uh; lungtang diktat pu tengteng in asuang ding uhi.
